invariants.text: Source design intent: Unity 6.3 LTS, URP first game, PC first; actual installed patch/package baseline must be inspected. Core contracts avoid pipeline-specific types.
Mouse/keyboard and gamepad; intended solo plus exactly two-player online. Network backend is not chosen by this overlay.
Use supported UCC character-execution seams before parallel motors/ability stacks; keep campaign/economy/session authority explicitly owned.
Do not import Galaxy coordinates, RNG architecture, scales, resource percentages or milestone numbers. Do not mandate a global event bus.
Preserve movement/attack-direction independence and approved proof order; retain mixed narrative statuses. Fictional AGI is not permission to add real LLM/API services.
High-frequency combat must remain satisfying without rare weapons, vehicles or meta progression; economy, routing, progression and story support rather than replace the core verb.

Temporary overwhelming power is the invariant, not a required driveable vehicle. Persistent progression remains horizontal or tightly bounded; no mandatory gear score or strong damage/health treadmill.
Use one or two consequential route choices per operation. Combat creates resource decisions that alter later combat; theme/location/objective state/tactical rules communicate one another.

Interaction -> source inheritance -> product -> framework/actual second consumer -> polished vertical slice -> explicit production gate. Future co-op feasibility is not permission to implement networking before stable solo contracts.

Historical target: solo evenings/weekends, short 5-10-minute proof stages and roughly 10-20-minute premium operations; 60 FPS on the stated RTX 2070 Mobile laptop is an unmeasured product target, not an allocated subsystem budget. Reconcile current constraints before planning.

Do not revive VECTOR RIFT time travel/eras/portals/anchors, fixed six-part weapon, five vehicles or its oversized milestone/mode/replay scope. No universal engine, mandatory global event bus or blanket owned-library integration.

Asset ownership is not production acceptance. Before approved runtime adoption verify compatibility, canonical ownership, testability, production value, representative behavior and exit path. Preserve all candidate/HOLD/reference-only statuses in the source asset register; do not copy its entire catalog into routine task context.

Network-host authority does not decide another human's narrative choice, save ownership or consent. Preserve equal human access to approved core verbs and critical information; optional bots and future session behavior require explicit contracts.

When the opening-arc baseline is adopted for a task, retrieve its actual status ledger and complete relevant sections. The source skill requires player-earned causality, optional lore/HQ, equal participation and no narrative punishment; M1 no AGI, M2 ambiguous help, late M3 direct contact, no actionable containment before the M6-8 window. This overlay does not approve those narrative records or select an exact rescue mission.

open_decisions: Inspect actual project paths, versions, packages, tests and unique baseline contracts.
Behavior Designer Pro 3 is approved for validation, not automatically production; A*, Rewired and network candidates require their own approval.
Retrieve current camera, drone, revive, downed-fire and bot policies; this overlay makes no choices.
Reconcile September 2 concept/perspective records against later approved narrative; numbered conversation replies and candidate wording are not approval.
Resolve friendly fire, exact progression, power form/cadence, health/failure/save/consent rules and authored/procedural ratio only for affected approved work.
Xbox remains conditional; mobile, four-player, split-screen, public replay and additional modes are deferred, not hidden implementation requirements.
facts: Source-derived intent only, not installation evidence.
UCC and purchased assets are not redistributed.
Historical baseline constraints are retained for reconciliation; no fresh game-design approval, current installed capability or spending authorization is inferred.
